p1_findings.title: Primary spec dev-workflow-platform.md has 0% source coverage
p1_findings.description: 69 FRs (FR-001..069) in the 'most critical' spec have zero source implementation or traceability comments. Either the wrong system was built or the spec is aspirational.
p1_findings.recommendation: Requirements-reviewer to decide: (A) spec is aspirational → update CLAUDE.md; (B) wrong system built → align implementation. Decision required before next sprint planning.

p2_findings.title: tiered-merge-pipeline.md (FR-TMP-001..010) fully unimplemented
p2_findings.description: All 10 tiered merge pipeline requirements have zero source references. FR-TMP-001 through FR-TMP-010 cover risk classification, E2E generation, auto-PR, AI review, auto-merge.
p2_findings.recommendation: Route to TheATeam or TheFixer as a new pipeline task. Mark spec as 'planned/not started' in the meantime.

p2_findings.title: Missing dependencyCheckDuration histogram (FR-dependency-metrics)
p2_findings.description: FR-dependency-metrics requires 4 Prometheus metrics. Three counters present; dependencyCheckDuration histogram (dependency_check_duration_seconds) is absent. Test also does not check for it.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add histogram to metrics.ts, instrument in dependency.ts, add test case in metrics.test.ts.

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer only checks 13/96 spec requirements
p2_findings.description: Enforcer reads Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md (13 FRs only). Reports PASSED while 79 FRs in Specifications/ are completely untraced. CLAUDE.md verification gate gives false confidence.
p2_findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to scan all Specifications/ for FR-XXX pattern IDs. Solo session, no pipeline required.
